Access.name: isClienteConConsulenzaRispAmm
Access.Query: SELECT case when count(*) > 0 then 'S' else 'N' END as isClienteWealthConConsulenzaRispAmm FROM ( SELECT ce.contr_n, ce.prod_c, ce.codice_dato, ce.dato, cc.cli_c FROM cll.contr_estesa ce LEFT JOIN cll.contrcli cc ON TRIM(ce.prod_c) = TRIM(cc.prod_c) AND TRIM(ce.contr_n) = TRIM(cc.contr_n) AND TRIM(cc.prod_c) IN ('BAN91', 'BAN93', 'BAN97') WHERE 1 = 1 AND ce.codice_dato IN ( 10501, 10504, 10502, 10503 ) ) PIVOT ( MAX(dato) FOR codice_dato IN ( 10501 AS attivo, 10504 AS percportaf, 10502 AS dtiniziovalid, 10503 AS dtfinevalid ) ) WHERE attivo = 'S' AND sysdate BETWEEN TO_DATE(dtiniziovalid, 'yyyymmdd') AND TO_DATE(dtfinevalid, 'yyyymmdd') AND cli_c = lpad(?, 11, '0')
